newsitem.title: UK: Concert set for more aggressive U.S course.
newsitem.headline: Concert set for more aggressive U.S course.

text.p: MCI said its planned merger with BT means it will set out a more aggressive course in its U.S. home market as the new entity, called Concert, will give it the financial strength for increased investments.
"We will be more aggressive," Gerald Taylor, MCI's president and chief operating officer, told a news conference.
"It gives us the strength...to look at the opportunities before us," he said. "This is an industry with a ferocious appetite for capital."
But when asked, Taylor ruled out any bids for local phone operators because regulations do not allow the so-called baby Bells to get involved in long distance operations.
"But even if we could do it, I am not sure sure whether we want to," Taylor told Reuters after the conference. "I cannot see what they can offer us."
